01 / About Me

The mind behind the machine

I'm a results-driven AI/ML Engineer and MCA graduate from Presidency College, Bengaluru. My passion lives at the intersection of large language models, retrieval systems, agentic AI, and scalable backend architectures.

During my 3-month AI/ML internship at VSPAN Technology Solutions, I designed and delivered 4 production-grade AI systems — from RAG-powered financial chatbots to agentic web scrapers and hospital intelligence platforms, using LangChain, LangGraph, FAISS, and modern LLM APIs.

I'm deeply excited about building GenAI-driven applications that solve real business problems — multi-agent systems, function-calling workflows, and cloud-deployed AI backends that are technically sound and genuinely impactful.

When I'm not engineering AI systems, I'm exploring the latest in GenAI — from Hugging Face model hubs to LangGraph orchestration patterns and vector database optimisation strategies.
